# Rhetorical frame fixtures

`guide.md.txt` contains constructed development probes, not a labeled evaluation
corpus. Its one Ptah clause is quoted from the source below. The probes vary nouns,
contractions, punctuation, inline code, and block boundaries. Technical controls
retain useful definitions and prohibitions. Expected notes leave the gate open.
The complete golden records both clauses and all repeated occurrences.

`ptah.md.txt` preserves the complete page supplied in #294, with one `want`
annotation added on the line where its document self-description starts. The
harness adds BOM/CRLF and masks annotations before analysis. Consequently the
materialized test input intentionally differs from the original source hash.
